Samir — appreciate the clarity. Below is a concise side-by-side we use to normalize across vendors. I kept the numbers to per‑1M tokens so you can multiply against your monthly bands. These are simplified list/host prices (actual contractual pricing varies by commit and model selection):

Per‑1M tokens (list / typical public rates) — ballpark numbers for comparison:
- OpenAI (gpt-4x-like endpoint): ~$60 / 1M tokens (higher for longer contexts; includes higher generation pricing).
- Anthropic (Claude-like): ~$45 / 1M tokens.
- Common open-model hosts (Replicate / HuggingFace hosts / smaller vendors): $20 — $35 / 1M tokens depending on model and acceleration.

Redwood pricing (indicative scenarios for MedTech AI):
- Redwood Hosted (self-serve, no commit): $28 / 1M tokens — reliable latency SLOs, standard throttles.
- Redwood Hosted (volume discounted estimate @ 500M+/mo): $18 / 1M tokens — subject to a 3‑month volume review and platform credits applied.
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity, 12mo commit): $7 — $10 / 1M tokens depending on commit size and model quantization choices (this assumes you accept a dedicated GPU pool and commit to baseline throughput).

Observations tailored to your workload:
- Multi-turn clinical summarization generates sizable KV cache reuse — that favors dedicated pools (lower per‑token marginal cost because KV cache persists across requests).
- Open-model hosts can be cheaper raw but often lack predictable latency and persistent cache guarantees, which increases effective cost for your interactive triage flow.
- Our committed/dedicated numbers are competitive when you reach sustained 400–500M+ monthly tokens. At 200M/mo the hosted discounted option (mid-teens $/1M) is the usual recommendation.

Proposal / next steps:
1) If MedTech confirms 200M pilot, we put together a 30‑day pilot quote: Hosted discounted tier for the pilot (target $18 / 1M) with Net30 invoice terms and SOC2 attestation attached.
2) If MedTech prefers committed economics, Ben can scope a Dedicated 12‑month commit with target effective $8.50 / 1M at 12mo baseline of 500M/mo. This will require a short technical onboarding window but gives predictable unit economics.
3) I’ll share a short Excel that lets you plug in the monthly token targets and see total monthly spend across each option.

Can we schedule a 30‑min pricing & contract call Tue or Wed next week? Ben can join to walk through Dedicated sizing if you want to evaluate that route.

Thanks — I’ll attach the spreadsheet and slide again.

— Evelyn
